processing.webSettings: 3072x1536, 24fps inherited, fast preset, CRF 23, maxrate 5M, bufsize 10M, GOP 48, keyint_min 24, yuv420p, no audio, faststart
processing.sourceProjection: Approximate dual-lens conversion; not the calibrated Insta360 Studio stitch
processing.photoWalls: 24 static image panels sampled from the outbound interval; sky-key transparency; illustrative geometry
processing.returnMapping: Monotonic approximate correspondence from reconstructed trajectories; not measured GNSS

limitations: Photo walls are flat and contain visible seams and baked-in cars/trees.
Street dimensions and photo placement are illustrative, not geographically surveyed.
Video remains on the recorded path; no lateral viewpoint movement.
Turnaround cuts between different lanes at an approximately matched location.
Web previews are compressed copies, not the original resolution or bitrate.
Desktop and phone-sized browser checks are not certification on physical phones.
rights: Owner-supplied footage. No open reuse license inferred. Three.js retains its bundled MIT notice.
